_comment: Per-repo metadata, keyed by GITHUB_REPO_AUTOMATION. `framework` is a fallback for shared/frameworks/detect.py when the repo's build files do not settle it. `reference_files` are the repo-relative files the authoring agent shows the model as worked examples: one module end to end (data, builder, helper, API client, page objects with their real base-page import block, and a web and an API test). Missing files are skipped; with no list, the model works from the repo's CLAUDE.md alone. `shared_code` lists the repo-relative directories or files of the framework's shared code (base page, waits, assertions, data helpers); the authoring agent indexes their public members so the model calls them instead of writing its own. Without it there is no shared index.
